title: IAM feature dependency invariants (service accounts, resource permissions)
answers: Can I enable serviceaccounttokens without serviceaccounts?
Why did startup fail with 'iam api requires' error?
What are the dependency rules between IAM APIs?
body: APIServiceTokensAPI requires ServiceAccountsAPI to be enabled, and ServiceAccountResourcePermissions requires ResourcePermissionsAPI. This is enforced in Features.Validate() in pkg/registry/apis/iam/features.go and must be called after building a Features value from ParseAPIs/SetAPIs (e.g. in whatever startup wiring constructs the explicit config) — skipping it lets an inconsistent feature set reach the builder, where token or resource-permission storage could be wired without its prerequisite API.
applies: Anywhere a Features value is assembled from startup config before being passed via iam.WithFeatures
